An available, downloading, ready, mandatory, blocked or store update, with its release notes and the right verb for the outlet, such as Update on the App Store or Restart when ready. Only a mandatory update blocks; an available one is a quiet offer.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    **Drop-in.** `update` (`check`, `download --to <path>`, `apply`) with the progress bar.

    **Styled part.** `screens.update(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `update_view(decision, current=…)` → `UpdateView` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
